mapper.sql: sb.id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ri.attributes_json, '$.legacyRoomId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS room_id, ri.instance_name AS room_name, sb.user_id, su.username, sb.start_time, sb.end_time, sb.status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sb.ext_json, '$.rejectReason')) AS reject_reason, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sb.ext_json, '$.title')) AS title, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sb.ext_json, '$.reason')) AS reason, sb.create_time
FROM schedule_booking sb LEFT JOIN resource_instance ri ON sb.resource_instance_id = ri.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON sb.user_id = su.id
